Here's the .apworld and the YAML for the ADOFAI_AP-Mod:
https://github.com/ClaudeChibout/ADOFAI_AP-Mod

## What's new
- Add the levels from cosmic radio island

## How to install
1. Download the .apworld below and double-click it (or drop it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder)
2. Grab the mod from https://github.com/ClaudeChibout/ADOFAI_AP-Mod
3. Follow the included ADOFAI_Setup_and_YAML_Guide.pdf if you need a step-by-step walkthrough
